title: Cobblemon Menu Background
description: This project adds a cool Cobblemon imge to the Main Menu Screen of Minecraft Java!
body:
![This image shows the first letters of "Cobblemon Menu Background" in a cool gradient! ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a9361ac08c5f88cd69f3aaf697a995a47110c140.png)

## Additions:
This lightweight resource pack changes the default Minecraft main‑menu background for a cinematic Cobblemon‑themed image featuring Mewtwo. The moment you launch the game, you’re greeted with a dramatic scene: Mewtwo standing over a Minecraft landscape, framed by towering stone arches and warm sunset lighting. It’s a simple change, but it gives the menu a fresh, atmospheric vibe without altering anything else in your game.


Perfect for players who enjoy playing Cobblemon and want to change their Main Menu Screen! Thanks for downloading this Reasource Pack!
